title: Anthropic says Fable 5 is available on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans through June 22, after which using Fable 5 will require usage credits (Rebecca Bellan/TechCrunch)
summary: Rebecca Bellan / TechCrunch: Anthropic says Fable 5 is available on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans through June 22, after which using Fable 5 will require usage credits — Anthropic is bringing its most powerful AI model to the general public for the first time, but it's doing it with guardrails.
